subject: Cloud channel packaging & regional priority - finalizing SKUs
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 08:12:00 -0800
Subject: Cloud channel packaging & regional priority - initial draft

Team —

Quick one to align on a minimal-first approach for the marketplace listings across AWS/Azure/GCP. I pulled a lean SKU matrix (attached) and sketched regional priority where we should push co-sell vs self-serve. High level asks:

- Can the channel teams confirm which SKUs we want available in each cloud day-one vs Q1 FY27?
- Any blockers for co-sell enablement (contracts, co-marketing assets)?
- Agree on a single SKU to prioritize for the first wave to avoid fragmentation (my suggestion: "Reserved Inference-Base")

Attached: sku_channel_priority_v2.csv (simple matrix) and a one-pager checklist.

Notes from my side:
- AWS: focus on US-East and US-West for co-sell; prefer a compact SKU that maps to our Dedicated plan.
- Azure: target Gov/Enterprise later — start with West Europe + US West for partner-led deals.
- GCP: prioritize self-serve initially but enable co-sell for strategic accounts.

Please reply with redlines by EOD Thursday. If we agree, I want to lock the listing strategy before we sync with cloud partners next week.

Thanks,
Soojin
Soojin Lee
Senior Manager, Cloud GTM 
Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Cloud channel packaging & regional priority - initial draft

Soojin —

Thanks for pulling this together. A few quick points from channel pricing/ops:

- SKU granularity: Let’s keep 2 SKUs per offering family (Base and Scale). Too many SKUs will cost us in listing management and confuse co-sell counterparts.
- Pricing floors: For AWS marketplace we need to respect their minimums for BYOL/reserved billing; I can share the table.
- Region availability: I agree on US cores first but recommend adding EU-West as the 2nd priority for Azure (lots of pipeline there).

I attached an ops-friendly mapping in the CSV under the tab "ops_notes" — two things to confirm: whether we permit trial credits in marketplace listings (affects billing flow), and whether Dedicated SKU includes optional burst lanes (that affects our metering).

I can be on the partner sync if helpful — I can walk the billing implications.

-karthik
Director, GTM Ops
Redwood Inference

From: Chris Sullivan <chris.sullivan@amazon.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 2 Dec 2026 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Cloud channel packaging & regional priority - initial draft

Hi Soojin / team —

Appreciate the concise matrix. From AWS Marketplace PM POV:

- Co-sell readiness: We like the single-priority SKU approach; a clear co-sell SKU simplifies our Enablement and listing accelerator.
- Listing cadence: If you want co-sell support in Q1, please submit the listing package (pricing docs, logos, marketing blurb) by Dec 10 to hit our Feb co-sell kickoff.
- Technical: Metering and SKU packaging look fine, but we need explicit language around burst capacity — how it is metered and billed.

Questions:
1) Do you have a preferred default SKU for the AWS catalog entry (name + short description)?
2) Will you allow trial credits on the Marketplace listing? That affects procurement flow for some prospects.

Happy to hop on a 30-min call next Tue to go through the intake form.

Best,
Chris Sullivan
Partner PM, AWS Marketplace
chris.sullivan@amazon.com

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Chris Sullivan <chris.sullivan@amazon.com>, Emily Zheng <emily.zheng@gcp-partners.com>, Tina Kim <tina.kim@microsoft.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 2 Dec 2026 10:24:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Cloud channel packaging & regional priority - initial draft

Thanks Chris — helpful. Quick decisions from our side (confirming for the intake):

- Default catalog SKU: "Redwood Reserved Inference - Base" with short desc: "Production-grade LLM inference (reserved capacity). Low-latency, burstable lanes, billed per-second."
- Trial credits: yes, we will enable limited trial credits (30K token equivalent) for marketplace trials; will document redemption flow.
- Burst metering: will be metered as an add-on line item per minute of burst usage; ops to provide exact meter name.

Next steps:
- Karthik to export final ops mapping and confirm metering names by Dec 6.
- Jonas/Laura to prepare the co-sell collateral bundle (1-pager + logo + case study snippet) by Dec 8.
- Soojin will schedule the intake call with AWS for Dec 14.

Attaching the latest SKU matrix and a co-sell readiness checklist for reference. If everyone is aligned I will send the intake invite and include the AWS intake form link.

Cheers,
Soojin
Senior Manager, Cloud GTM
Redwood Inference
Attachments: co_sell_readiness_checklist.pdf (1 page), sku_channel_priority_v2.csv (updated)
